title: Manage people
caption: The People tab groups account creation, password recovery and session controls.
note: Check whether the main actions are easy to find.

title: Create an invitation
caption: The Invitations tab explains the seven-day, single-use invitation and its empty state.
note: The generated-link and signup-form screens were not captured.

title: Arrive in a private home
caption: A recipient followed an invitation, chose credentials and landed in an empty personal home.
note: New accounts start without access to the legacy shared space.

title: Edit after a username invitation
caption: The owner granted editing access by username. The recipient signed in and created the visible note.
note: Look at the Can edit label and the available editing tools.

title: Edit after accepting a link
caption: Fido opened an editing invitation, signed in, joined the board and added a contribution.
note: This is the joined-board outcome; the join form was not captured.

title: Choose an agent connection scope
caption: Connections name their access mode and selected boards. The token itself is excluded from this pack.
note: Review the board labels and the distinction between read-only and proposals.

title: Preview a proposed layout
caption: A real SDK client staged four objects. The native app displayed the proposed board before approval.
note: This earlier native capture precedes the final preview text-contrast fix; see the final browser views below.

title: Approve and see the live cards
caption: After approval, the note, column, checklist and link appeared on the live board.
note: The proposal has now changed the board, rather than only its preview.

title: Reverse the applied proposal
caption: Reversing the proposal removed its objects from the live board; the proposal status became reversed.
note: Review whether the reversal result is understandable.

title: Review the final dark preview
caption: The final browser capture shows the gold note with the corrected text color and the spaced column heading.
note: Compare the card contrast and approval action placement.

title: Review the final narrow preview
caption: The same proposal fits in a narrow light-theme window without clipping its cards.
note: Review the stacked layout, board selector and approval controls.

title: Leave a complete note in progress
caption: The full note was observed in the editor before closing the window.
note: This is a captured state, not a recording of the close gesture.

title: Reopen after Cmd+W
caption: The complete note remained visible after Cmd+W and reopening the app.
note: Text preservation was also checked with the red window-close button.

title: Inspect the final save details
caption: The latest native build shows the shared contributions and zero waiting changes or image uploads.
note: Review the quiet Save status control and the detail panel.

title: Keep typing while offline
caption: The full offline note is visible in the active editor while the status reads Offline.
note: The local test server was stopped; this was a real offline check.

title: Reopen while still offline
caption: The app was quit and reopened before the server returned. The complete note survived.
note: Compare the note text with the preceding screenshot.

title: Reconnect and finish syncing
caption: After restarting the same local server, the note stayed intact and pending work reached zero.
note: Review the transition back to the quiet save state.

title: Export a recovery copy
caption: Download unsynced changes opens a native JSON Save dialog. Cancel returns to the editor and keeps the recovery copy.
note: The dialog is captured here; the preceding access-change notification is not.
